question: Related Questions Q. I am an new overseas student at an american university. I was looking for a place to live in the vicinity of the campus and mosque. Me and my friends found a place near to both, but it is owned jointly by the local church and a contractor. The advantage of this apartment over others is that it has a short lease period (I may want to leave for another university in the next 3 months). Is it permissible for me to live in such an apartment when I know that the funds received by the church can go for their activities like preaching (perhaps even to my fellow muslims and/or non-muslims) and worship activities inside the church. I am intending on moving if I get a better accomodation, but the lease is valid for 3 months before which I have to pay a fine for leaving the apartment. I can still however afford to move if it is Haram to live there JazaKAllah, 1610 views Q. Can a company representative use samples goods personally? 1412 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 164380 Country: India Title: Can I purchase vehicle or any product in EMI? Question: Can I purchase vehicle or any product in EMI? For example: If the cost of product is 5000₹ then by opting EMI will have to pay ₹5200 or more. Is EMI permissible in Islam? Answer ID: 164380 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1299/973/SN=01/1440) If you directly deal with the dealer and shopkeeper with no bank or finance company involved in between then it is lawful as per the Shariah to buy any vehicle or goods on installment provided the total price and duration of payment is fixed in the initial meeting of transaction. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
